description: v4 only. The tokens a wallet actually holds that v4 can take, per token and summed across chains, with 'perChain' saying where each sits, plus the best supply APY and lowest borrow APY the protocol currently offers on that token. This is the wallet, not a position: nothing here is supplied or borrowed yet, and the rates alongside a balance are what Aave would pay or charge, not what the wallet is earning. Start a 'what should I do with what I have' question here and a 'how is my position doing' question at get_user_summary. Omit chainId to cover every chain v4 serves, stated under 'chainsCovered'. Zero balances are left out.

chainId.description: Chain id to restrict to, e.g. 1 for Ethereum. Omit the argument entirely to cover every chain.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_wallet_balances
title: What a wallet holds that Aave accepts (v4)
